name: citely-audit
description: Agent Skill Marketplace that audits an arbitrary website for off-site AI discoverability and on-site engagement, emitting a single evidence-backed JSON report.

skills.description: Sequences the audit: single safe crawl + render, runs the four analysis skills, merges/ranks findings, computes the discoverability score, validates and emits the final report.
Mechanic 1 — Access, Render/Readability (raw-vs-rendered diff or browserless heuristic), and Fact Extraction over the shared crawl artifact.
Mechanics 2 + 3 — RAG quotability and information-density / summarizer-survival analysis over rendered HTML.
Mechanic 4 — structured-data (JSON-LD/OG/microdata) entity-graph extraction, plus sameAs and third-party-anchor analysis over the links the page itself publishes. No network access.
Mechanic 5 — deterministic first-viewport orientation and visitor-retention heuristics over the rendered DOM.

Prescription rather than detection — turns findings into copy-paste snippets with a validation procedure, and adds non-obvious proactive suggestions where no defect was found. Never invents business facts.

_note: marketplace.json and the `entrypoint` flag are this brief's own lightweight convention, not part of the base agentskills.io spec, which defines only the per-skill folder + SKILL.md. Skills are keyed by `id` because that is the key the brief's own manifest example uses, and the published example is the only specification this convention has. `id` matches the skill folder name and the SKILL.md `name` frontmatter, which the spec requires to match the folder.
